site: Mayor Glenda Hood Park on New Broad Street
Holiday tree where Santa does the lighting
about: A local event page for the same night puts the crowd at more than 20,000 guests expected and lists a holiday parade, a tree lighting, photos with Santa and food trucks.
The city page names local artists among the attractions, alongside live holiday performances and stilt walkers.
The parade is the centerpiece of the evening. It starts at 7 PM and heads toward Lake Baldwin, and Santa lights the holiday tree once it ends.
The event is held in Baldwin Park Village in the 32814 zip code, and the City of Orlando carries the listing on its events calendar.
faq: Is the Baldwin Park Winter Wonderland Extravaganza free?
Yes. The City of Orlando lists the cost as free.
When is the parade?
The lighted parade is at 7 PM on Saturday, December 5, 2026.
Where is it?
Mayor Glenda Hood Park, 4990 New Broad Street, Orlando, FL 32814.
Can kids meet Santa?
Yes. The city lists a chance to take pictures with Santa, and Santa lights the tree after the parade.
What activities are there?
Kids' activities, live holiday performances, local artists, food, stilt walkers and face painting.
Who do I contact with questions?
The city lists Adam Bailey at Tim Webber Events, 407-719-4488.

site: Craft tables run by the Leu Gardens team
Harry P. Leu Gardens grounds on N Forest Ave
about: The gardens describe Holiday Craft Day as a chance to add a creative touch to a garden visit, with the crafts included with regular admission.
The gardens page carries logos for the City of Orlando, the Friends of Leu Gardens, Orlando Health and Orange County Arts and Cultural Affairs.
The gardens also sell tickets to Dazzling Nights, their holiday lights event, which has its own listing.
Visitors of all ages can take part, according to the gardens.
faq: How much is Holiday Craft Day?
The crafts are included with garden admission, which is $15 for adults and $10 for children.
What time is Holiday Craft Day?
It runs from 10 AM to 1 PM on Saturday, December 5, 2026.
What crafts can kids make?
A snowman ornament, a mini wreath and snowball slime.
Where is it?
Harry P. Leu Gardens, 1920 N Forest Ave, Orlando, FL 32803.
What are the garden hours?
The gardens list hours of 9 AM to 4 PM, with last entry one hour before closing.
Is the Leu House open?
The gardens say the Historic Leu House Museum is temporarily closed.
